description: High-contrast developer-first AI engineering suite and reference platform.

tools.name: search_dictionary
tools.description: Search 77 categorized AI engineering concepts across Foundations, Prompting, RAG, Agents, Speed, Evals, and WebMCP.

query.description: Search keyword or conceptual phrase (e.g., 'Speculative Decoding', 'KV Cache', 'BM25').

category.description: Optional category filter: 'Foundations', 'Prompting & Inference', 'RAG & Search', 'Agents & Multi-Agent', 'Performance & Speed', 'Evals & Benchmarks', 'Protocols & WebMCP'.

tools.name: diagnose_prompt
tools.description: Diagnose an AI prompt against 8 strict production engineering rules (negative constraints, few-shot examples, JSON schemas, role clarity, context placement, stop sequences, boundary rules, token efficiency).

tools.name: generate_agent_spec
tools.description: Generate an open Linux Foundation compliant AGENTS.md specification file for a repository.

tech_stack.description: Primary tech stack (e.g. 'Python, FastAPI, Docker, SQLite').

tools.name: calculate_speculative_speed
tools.description: Calculate theoretical speedup and token throughput for speculative decoding based on draft model parameters, target model size, draft length gamma, and acceptance rate alpha.

target_params_b.description: Target model size in billions of parameters (e.g. 70).

draft_params_b.description: Draft model size in billions of parameters (e.g. 2).

draft_length_gamma.description: Number of speculative tokens proposed per step (typically 3 to 8).

acceptance_rate_alpha.description: Draft token acceptance rate between 0.0 and 1.0 (e.g. 0.75).

memory_bandwidth_gb_s.description: GPU memory bandwidth in GB/s (e.g. 2000 for A100, 3350 for H100).
